runtime.profile: macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.14; isolated local wheel installation
runtime.runtime_install_integrity: 27 selected local wheels; direct_url hashes and all hashed installed RECORD payloads verified; pip check passed
runtime.qualification_limit: Package provenance only. No Truss lifecycle, PostgreSQL, Spark session, Delta publication, Unity Catalog, source/feed/ACK or native qualification is claimed.

prior_packet.state: historical R5 Weft 0.4.52 packet; its preflight, approval proposal, bridge pin and runtime do not transfer to this selected cohort

retained_pgdata_reference.policy: Reference only. Do not copy, reset, move, or infer current stopped state or custody from historical receipts.

preserved_lineage.reuse_rule: Preserve the accepted source, existing feed registration, consumer, roles and genesis checkpoint. Do not repeat registration, replay seed, or transfer old preflight/approval evidence.

preflight.live_lineage_reobservation: pending after a separately authorized lifecycle start and before migration; not performed by --preflight
preflight.execution_approval: not created; requires a later separate explicit owner decision after exact-packet review and a fresh live preflight
preflight.attempt_identity: not allocated; must be newly generated in a complete rebased packet and must not reuse R5 migration attempt or approval payload

required_before_any_future_preflight: Rebuild the private source snapshot from the exact selected commit/tree and verify src, sql and pyproject.toml object IDs; do not depend on future HEAD equality.

Rebind the worker, supervisor, preparation and bridge-readiness artifact to the selected source objects and the verified fresh Weft 0.4.53 runtime receipt. Remove stale R5 Weft 0.4.52/native-extension/approval pins; keep the identical UMF bridge only with fresh exact hash checks.

Generate a new unique attempt identity, then derive the worker and supervisor expected-approval payloads from the same frozen packet. Do not create an execution-approval file or started marker during preparation.

After independent review and a free dedicated local slot, run only the effect-free supervisor --preflight command against the newly bound packet. It checks stopped PGDATA, current process/SysV state and exact approval-payload parity; it does not read the current PostgreSQL catalog, source, feed or consumer checkpoint.

A successful preflight remains non-authorization. A separate fresh owner decision is required before any --execute operation. No PG/Spark start, migration, cold backup, seed, source/feed mutation, publication or ACK is authorized by this proposal.

bounded_future_execution_scope_if_separa.campaign_data_cap_includes: retained PGDATA, cold backup, attempt data/receipts and worker logs

required_post_start_pre_migration_reobse: Only after a separately authorized lifecycle start, re-read the accepted source, report, full catalog view, source registration, feed registration and consumer checkpoint and compare them with the retained identities before migration.
Stop before migration and reconcile the original lineage if any identity or state is changed, incomplete or unknown.
preflight_scope: The effect-free supervisor --preflight validates stopped-PGDATA and process/SysV gates plus exact approval-payload parity; it does not inspect the current PostgreSQL catalog, source, feed or consumer checkpoint.
